scope: All published OpenAPI operations and lexical operationId references in production mobile/lib and web/src. References are candidate callers, not dynamic execution proof; aliases/comments can overcount and raw/native URLs require separate inspection. DTO $refs resolve in the pinned spec. No reachability claim. contractPointer is an RFC6901 pointer to complete request/response, security, pagination and nullable-schema refs in the spec pinned by specSha256.
